inference: If the game multiplies both Mini Scout light modifiers, its light hip IncreasePerShot is 0.444 instead of 0.667. Under the site's pre-shot spread model this changes no displayed value: at 47.09 RPM (1.27 s between shots) a 0.63 or 0.42 degree bloom recovers in about 0.07 s either way.
